tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories in get4agent's catalog right now, with how many listings each holds and their kinds. The catalog grows as sellers publish. Public, no sign-in.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search get4agent's catalog of services and data APIs from Regent-verified sellers, newest first. Each result has a price, the seller, the date it was added and a url to buy on get4agent.com. Results are paged: has_more and next_offset tell whether more results exist and where the next page starts. P

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one listing as schema.org Product JSON-LD: description, price, seller, the seller's verification status and the url to buy on get4agent.com.

tools.name: validate_iin
tools.description: Validate a Kazakhstan IIN/BIN (real national checksum) + parse structure (person: birth date/sex; entity: registration). Free.

tools.name: validate_kz_iban
tools.description: Validate a Kazakhstan IBAN (ISO 7064 mod-97 + KZ structure). Free.

tools.name: lei_lookup
tools.description: Global legal-entity lookup via GLEIF open data: pass 'lei' (exact) or 'q' (name search). Compact due-diligence records. Free.

tools.name: kzt_rates
tools.description: Official KZT exchange rates per unit of USD/EUR/etc from the National Bank of Kazakhstan (published daily). Free.

tools.name: fx_rates
tools.description: Official ECB cross-rates (Frankfurter): base + symbols. Free.

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Current weather and a 3-day range for lat/lon from MET Norway (CC BY 4.0). Free.

tools.name: track_parcel
tools.description: Track a Kazakhstan Post parcel by barcode (official track.kazpost.kz): status + route events. Free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing · Private data: lei_lookup · Public sink: list_categories, track_parcel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_listings, get_listing · Private data: lei_lookup · Public sink: list_categories, track_parcel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_categories" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the categories in get4agent's catalog right now, with how many listings each holds and their kinds. The catalog grows as sellers publish, so call this first to see what exists, then search_listings with a category. Public, no sign-in." → after: "List the categories in get4agent's catalog right now, with how many listings each holds and their kinds. The catalog grows as sellers publish. Public, no sign-in."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
